unprovenOrBlocked: getWorkspaceAccess stays unimplemented: 03_api_contract_complete.yaml assigns it x-owner=workspace / x-tables=workspace.workspaces / x-feature-id=F09 while packages/contracts/proto/internal.proto declares rpc GetWorkspaceAccess on service ServeProductService. The authority admits a caller only when caller == console_bff || caller == audience, so an audience=workspace row cannot authorize Serve's own call either. Needs the canonical owner's decision; Serve adds no row and answers no projection.

The composed BFF delivery route GET /api/v2/delivery/{workspaceId} guards with GETWORKSPACE on audience=workspace and the policy table has no workspace-audience row at all, so the composed read is refused at the BFF before Serve is reached. That guard file is the identity integrator's and the switch is the workspace owner's.
No real Deploy, Runtime observation, image, Instance or production evidence exists. The harness seeds Serve-owned read rows and says so; it is not a deployment.

The shared authorizer collates every CloudIdentity client error into codes.Unavailable, so a policy denial is indistinguishable from an authority outage at owner boundaries. Recorded as a shared-infrastructure finding; not changed here.
